notes.directTauriInPluginCode: Must stay 0. Plugin code never imports @tauri-apps directly; everything goes through sdk.native/files/clipboard/http, so the 'native' permission and its `commands` allowlist are enforced. A new hit is a tool bypassing the permission/audit layer.
notes.sharedStoreInPluginCode: 2 known exceptions: one-time migrations that read keys predating plugin namespaces (apiclient/store.ts reads 'devtool:apiclient:activeEnv'; clockify/store.tsx reads migration flags and sweeps legacy keys). sdk.storage would namespace them to 'devtool:<id>:devtool:...'. They go away with those migrations. New keys must use usePluginState with legacyKey.
notes.manifestForeignImports: Invariant: manifests may import only lucide-react and @/platform; anything else breaks code splitting.
notes.secretishKeyInSharedStore: Invariant: no credentials in the shared store. This is a key-NAME tripwire, not proof of absence: 'devtool:apiclient:environments' once held tokens under an innocuous name (now handled by envSecrets.ts).
notes.anchorDownloadInPluginCode: Must stay 0. `<a download>` writes nothing in the Tauri webview; saving goes through lib/fileio.ts (saveTextFile/saveBinaryFile), the only place allowed to use it for the web fallback.
